# Code of Conduct

PIDhound follows the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1.

## In short

- Be respectful. Disagree on ideas, not people.
- Assume good faith.
- Help newcomers — many contributors will be writing their first Swift PR.
- No harassment, sexualized content, personal attacks, or political grandstanding in issues or PRs.

## Enforcement

Report problems by emailing the maintainer (see GitHub profile). The maintainer may warn, lock, or ban as they see fit. There is no formal committee — this is a small project.
